title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00140 — wellbore not published in this release

sections.text: Drained riser. Meanwhile prepared BPV plug and running tool. Changed to 3 1/2" handling equipment.

Rigged up modified trip tank on WH deck. Attempted to flowcheck well on modified trip tank from a-annulus. Unable to pump or getting returns. Rigged up new pump. Re-attempted to flowcheck well on modified trip tank. Found VR plug blinded off service wing on WH.
Discussed situation.
Performed TBT for removing flange on WH.
Removed flange on WH. Removed VR plug. Re-installed flange on WH. Installed circulation valves for modified trip tank.
Performed extended flow check of well over modified trip tank on WH. Well static for 45 min, then losses. Lost 130 ltr/hr for 15 min. Observed small gain ltrs), then static.
Continued flow checking well for 1 HR over modified trip tank on WH deck, static.
RIH and installed BPV plug
POOH with BPV RT. L/d same.
Performed TBT for pulling diverter
Prepared chains and lifting bridle for diverter. Pulled diverter
Pulled slip joint
Load shifted to BOP carrier. Removed tension cylinders
N/d BOP
Removed parts of scaffolding around riser to be able to skid over to test stump.
Moved BOP from well center to BOP test stump.
Removed remaining scaffolding around riser.
Performed TBT for pulling riser.

Removed master bushing and outer ring. Attached chains and lifting bridle to riser joint. Disconnected riser from WH. Removed hole cover and pulled riser joint to drill floor. Installed outer ring and master bushing. Installed hole cover.
Inspected tubing hanger. Observed increased u-tube from well while removing communication collar.
Performed TBT for installing riser
Pulled master bushing and outer ring. Installed riser.
Built scaffolding around riser joint
Moved BOP from stump to well center. Landed BOP on riser joint.
Finished scaffolding around riser.
M/u NT-2 connector.
Installed tension cylinders. Load shifted weight from BOP carrier to tension system.
Installed slip joint
Installed diverter. M/u slip joint
Performed TBT for BOP connector test
R/d chains from TDS. Installed BX elevator. Change to 3 1/2" inserts.
M/u BPV RT. RIH to 6m.
M/u bolts on slip joint
Pressureized diverter system and overshot packer.
Consulted onshore organization. Observed well on TT and modified TT on WH. Gained 240 ltr/20min at TT, lost 200 ltrs/20min on WH TT.

Consulted onshore organization. Well control duty and onshore organization concluded to perform BOP connector test and circulate well to even brine weight, no kill pill. Observed well on TT and modified TT on WH. Gained 140 ltr/20min at TT, lost 130 ltrs/20min on WH TT.
RIH with BPV dart RT to 20m. Installed dart. POOH
Lined up for connector test meanwhile flushed TT with clean brine
